title_review_en: feel free to book a stay at this magnificent hotel without any hesitation!
pos_review_en: the location of our hotel is right on the edge of the old town, up above. at first glance, this might seem negative, but it actually has a magnificent location. right as you step out of the hotel, you find yourself at the beginning of the liveliest two shopping streets in the city. you can stroll around until late at night. walking down from the hotel, you can effortlessly see all the historical sights. its location doesn't require any transportation; you can walk across the bridge to the farthest point on the other side of the river. if you get too tired, you can take an uber taxi back to the hotel for just 6 euros.  the most impressive part of the hotel is its cafe and restaurant located on the top floor. before heading out for the night, you can enjoy a drink and meal while taking in the magnificent panoramic view of the entire city. i believe it's one of the most beautiful spots in the city.  we stayed in the family room on the upper floor. i recommend opting for the panoramic view rooms; they're definitely worth it. when making a reservation, you might also consider adding breakfast; it's a lovely spread for the money. additionally, they offer luggage storage for early or late check-ins/check-outs. i would choose to stay here again without hesitation, so feel free to make a reservation.

pos_review_en: good location. rooms are spacious, clean and you get nice view is you are on higher floors. all facilities were great and we got a champagne as welcome drink. the rooftop bar is nice place to chill and relax and the cocktails were wonderful. i would definitely recommend this hotel.
neg_review_en: i tried to make a reservation for dinner and request for birthday cake on same day around noon but it was too late :( just was not expecting this for a 4-star hotel. in case you are planning such things, then inform hotel in advance and all will be sorted as they are very nice and helpful.

pos_review_en: great location, roof top, nice and helpful staff.

title_review_en: great value, convenient and comfortable stay in porto
pos_review_en: this is an extremely comfortable hotel with large size rooms that are well equipped. modern and convenient. i actually found the location very slightly away from the old town to be a relief from the intensity of the centre - but you could be back in the thick of it again within a 10 minute walk. plenty of good restaurants and convenience stores in close proximity. rooftop bar as well on fridays and saturdays as entertainment.
neg_review_en: nothing, this was a really good choice and good value.

pos_review_en: great and sumptuous breakfast, great staff, great location.

title_review_en: a delightful, multifaceted hotel in an excellent part of porto.
pos_review_en: the staff were excellent, as were the facilities, overall. the rooms were large with wonderful, panoramic balconies, though the interior lighting was rather dim. good location. fair price. very nice restaurant and lounge. parking in a massive care park 1 block from the hotel. we'd definitely return on another visit.
neg_review_en: dim interior lighting. bathroom was adequate, but cramped given the size of the room.

title_review_en: more expensive than our usual choices but very pleased with this hotel for a first visit to porto and portugal
pos_review_en: excellent location for metro links at trinidad and onwards for car hire (europcar). great breakfast, spectacular rooftop bar, very helpful staff when things go wrong (flight cancellation).

title_review_en: great location, comfortable, spacious, clean rooms, above & beyond staff
pos_review_en: the hotel dom henrique was perfect. the rooms were spacious and clean, the bed was very comfortable and the location was very conveniently located without the noise to interrupt a good nights sleep. the television station availability was superb, covering a wide variety of options. we could easily walk to local markets, restaurants, avenida dom afonso henriques to meet the hop-on hop-off buses and sao bento train station. the staff was more than accommodating for various requests, their restaurant recommendations were spot on, they really went above and beyond, very helpful & knowledgeable. lastly, their breakfast was extensive and delicious, more like a brunch. we knew little about this property prior to our stay but would highly recommend the stay.

title_review_en: good location, clean and beautiful view from the room.
pos_review_en: the terrace restourant is a unique place. coffee machine is in the room.
neg_review_en: the extra coffee capsule cost money.

title_review_en: comfortable, clean, great location, wonderful staff, and great food in hotel restaurant.
pos_review_en: excellent hotel. our room was very large with a great balcony with a beautiful view of porto. the bedroom and bathroom were modern, clean, and comfortable. the breakfast was delicious with a lot of variety. staff was friendly and helpful. great location for activities all over porto. fun rooftop bar.
excellent location and super clean facilities! highly recommended.

title_review_en: great hotel with fab breakfast would stop here again

location, room was great and view

title_review_en: a great option for a short business stay in porto.

neg_review_en: although it is next to a very convenient parking garage, the price was not included as a hotel guest.

pos_review_en: great location, helpful staff, beautiful hotel and phenomenal rooftop restaurant. amazing views of porto and very walkable area.
neg_review_en: when i booked the hotel, the description said there was parking. it wasn't until i got there that i realized there wasn't parking at the hotel. next door there is a parking garage which is very convenient however, they should work together to provide a more reasonable rate for hotel guests to park.

pos_review_en: the property was clean, well take care of and the tv pack was great!

the hotel was very clean and comfortable. the staff were attentive, and the bar/restaurant upstairs was delicious. the bathrooms are well stocked, and had comfy robes and slippers. although it's centrally located, it was very quiet for sleeping in the evenings.

i thought this hotel was excellent. good size room and bathroom, nice balcony and it was very quiet. temperature was easy to control, and i had a great nights sleep. the shower was strong with lots of hot water and a bottle of water left in my room. taxi was organised for the airport the following morning with no problems. this hotel is well placed for the main shopping street

spectacular view from our room, day and night! quiet, clean, fabulous bathroom and shower. breakfast was everything you could possibly want: eggs, bacon, breads, pastries, melon, fresh fruit, coffee, cappuccino, assorted juices, pancakes, waffles, yogurt. probably one of the nicest rooms we have ever stayed in.
good view of top floor restautant!
great localisation, nice view from the restaurance, deliciuos breakfast & dinner

the rooftop bar offers great views but its a very tight area that may not suit non-smokers. stayed in a comfort suite which was very well laid out as we were 2 friends sharing, although the lighting could have been a bit brighter in the bathroom and lobby area. we opted for room only rate and went to a lovely local cafe 1 min walk away with a mouth-watering selection of savoury and sweet pastries and great coffee at a more than reasonable price, probably eur4 pp
neg_review_en: the hotel is a good 25 min up hill walk from the main ribeiro area so if you don't like walking ensure you get taxis. additional pods for the coffee machine were by request and chargeable, c'mon a 4 star hotel and 4 star prices? i think the hotel is overpriced for location
not a great area for eating out alone

pos_review_en: great roof top bar & restaurant with friendly staff

title_review_en: i loved every second of my stay at hotel dom henrique and i plan on coming back!

location, space full room, great shower
